title: Revocable
summary: REV'OCABLE, adjective [Latin revocabilis. See Revoke.] That may be recalled or revoked; that may be repealed or annulled; as a revocable edict or grant.

inlines.v: REV'OCABLE, adjective [Latin revocabilis. See Revoke.] That may be recalled or revoked; that may be repealed or annulled; as a revocable edict or grant.
